instruction: Help me convert the image located at "/home/user/logo.png" to a true vector SVG file with scalable paths using GIMP.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot perform true raster-to-vector conversion to create scalable vector paths in SVG format. While GIMP can export to SVG, it only embeds the raster image as a data URI, not actual vector paths. True vectorization requires tools like Inkscape with tracing capabilities or Adobe Illustrator.
